witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the left disjunct. Instantiate data_buffer := retval_2, aligned := unsigned_last_nbits ((circular_area_length_pre ÷ 4) * 4) 32, and physical := repeat None (Z.to_nat aligned).
witnesses.space_plan: Use UCharArray.undef_full_to_mixed_full to turn the allocated undef_full buffer into mixed_full retval_2 aligned (repeat None (Z.to_nat aligned)). Rewrite readidx, writeidx, and b_status with PreH4-PreH6. Normalize sizeof(UCHAR)=1 so the p_tail cell matches data_buffer+aligned, then cancel/frame the eight descriptor fields into CircularAreaBackingResource.
witnesses.pure_plan: Use requested<=256 to meet the range helper's UINT bound, CircularArea_div4_aligned_range__init_return_branches to show the raw quotient-multiple lies in [0,2^32), and machine-integer normalization to remove unsigned_last_nbits. Use CircularArea_quot_eq_div_nonneg__init_return_branch_construction to change nonnegative Z quotient to Z division. Z.mul_quot_le and requested<=256 give aligned<=256, while aligned>0 is already PreH3. The remaining CircularAreaLogicalState facts follow for readidx=writeidx=b_status=0, logical=nil, and physical=repeat None: Zlength_repeat plus nonnegative aligned gives physical length; Forall and CircularAreaLiveBytes are vacuous; modulo-zero, empty/full status equivalences, and index bounds follow from aligned>0.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec or refinement-state obligation occurs in this return entailment.
